notes: All 306 fixtures come from the ESPN ksa.1 scoreboard feed (Tier 2), read one UTC date at a time for every date in the feed's own 2026-27 calendar (63 dates, 13 Aug 2026 - 28 May 2027). Checks passed: 18 clubs, each 17 home and 17 away; every ordered pair exactly once; 9 matches and 18 different clubs in every round; round k+17 is the exact reverse of round k for k = 1-17.

Round numbers: ESPN has none, so rounds follow the date blocks (R1 13-15 Aug ... R12 29-31 Oct, then one date per round). Moved matches keep their original round, per spl.com.sa (Tier 1): R3 Al Hilal v Al Ahli played 1 Sep; R8 Abha v Al Faisaly moved 11 Oct -> 27 Oct; R9 Al Riyadh v Al Hilal and Al Ittihad v Al Shabab moved to 19 Dec 2026, Al Ahli v Al Nassr to 6 Mar 2027; R10 Abha v Al Kholood moved 19 Oct -> 7 Dec (16:40 KSA). Spot checks agree: SPL's '10 matches to watch' gives MW 1, 2, 3, 5, 7, 8, 12, 15, 17 (x2); 365Scores match pages give R10, R11, R13, R17, R21, R22.

Kick-off times: 108 fixtures (all of rounds 1-12, including the five moved matches) have an ESPN time, so timeConfirmed true. Rounds 13-34 (198 fixtures) have only one date per round in ESPN (time 'TBD') and in 365Scores (17:00 placeholder). They are stored on that date at 17:00Z with timeConfirmed false. Matches in these rounds will probably be spread over 2-3 days once SPL announces dates and times. ESPN's own TBD placeholder (20:00Z) was not used because it falls on the next day in UAE time.

Round 11 began on 22 Oct with Al Hazem v Al Fayha and Al Fateh v Al Shabab (ESPN; 365Scores agrees for Al Fateh v Al Shabab: 22 Oct 14:45, Round 11). SPL's 23 Aug article (last modified 5 Oct) said MW11 would start on 23 Oct.

ESPN's &limit=100 copies for 25 Aug and 16, 19 and 20 Oct were stale. They were re-read with &lang=en&region=us: kick-offs are the same, but the stale 16 Oct copy still listed Al Riyadh v Al Hilal and Al Ittihad v Al Shabab (moved to 19 Dec), and those rows were dropped. The 19 Dec times (14:45Z, 17:30Z) and the 6 Mar 2027 time (19:00Z; 365Scores also shows 19:00) are ESPN times not TBD, so they count as confirmed, but SPL's own announcement gave no time for them.

Sabq's round-1 list (24 Jul) names Al Hazem before Abha. ESPN has Abha at home in round 1, and both ESPN and 365Scores have Al Hazem at home against Abha on 14 Dec (round 18), so Abha was kept as the round-1 home side.

Not usable: the spl.com.sa fixtures, team and match pages load by JavaScript and show 'No data available'. The TheSportsDB link was refused before it was sent (no search provenance), so Tier 3 was not used.

Before applying: data/competitions.json has no 'saudi-pro-league' yet, and data/teams.json lacks sa-abha, sa-al-diriyah, sa-al-faisaly, sa-al-fateh, sa-al-fayha, sa-al-hazem, sa-al-khaleej, sa-al-kholood, sa-al-riyadh and sa-al-shabab (no team ops in this patch). spl.com.sa links are not in sources.json yet, but every fixture also lists its ESPN page (Tier 2).
